items.title: BandLab Technologies buys Aiode, an AI music studio built on 'fully-licensed' audio
items.excerpt: BandLab Technologies acquired Aiode, an AI-powered music studio that lets creators build tracks using audio-to-audio models developed with professional session musicians. Its distinguishing pitch is that 100% of the training audio is licensed and traceable. Creators can generate performances section by section, spin up alternate takes and export projects as stems or full mixes - positioning it as a 'responsible' route for making music with AI.

items.title: Spotify expands its AI push with a ChatGPT-like music assistant
items.excerpt: Spotify launched a conversational AI assistant for Premium subscribers that lets listeners chat by voice or text to discover and control music, podcasts and audiobooks. In beta on iOS and Android in the US, Ireland and Sweden for users 18+, it blends Spotify's own AI with third-party language models, pushing AI-driven discovery well beyond the existing AI DJ.

items.title: Lorde slams Spotify's 'About the Song' feature over inaccurate AI-generated descriptions
items.excerpt: Lorde publicly criticized Spotify's beta 'About the Song' feature, which uses AI to generate song descriptions from third-party sources, after it published inaccurate details about her track 'Current Affairs.' She argued that reducing a song to an AI-generated meaning 'right at the source' limits free interpretation, and called for an artist opt-out. Spotify removed the offending text - a flashpoint over AI mediating how listeners understand music.
